items: Website safety check: missing security headers or a missing HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect now lower the score but no longer turn the verdict to caution on their own. On 394 popular sites the false-caution rate fell from 11.7% to 4.6% (95% interval 2.9-7.1%). Phishing detection is still not measured.
Published the first accuracy test (see the Accuracy section on this page), including the misses.

Prompt-injection check (version 1.1.0): added rules for "forget everything before" style openers, prompt-leak requests and the same in German and Spanish. On the held-out test set it now catches 15 of 60 injections (was 5 of 60) with no false alarms on 56 harmless texts.
Quickstart example for paying a call with a plain wallet (examples/quickstart.mjs).
MCP Registry listing updated to version 1.2.1.
Added /chain/preflight: checks a transaction or signature request before it is signed.
Added /federal-register: search US Federal Register rules, proposed rules and notices.
/chain/honeypot sell simulation now covers tokens traded against USDC.
Added /chain/honeypot (simulated sell test) and /chain/token-report.
Added /chain/sanctions and /package-check.
Payments accepted on Arc and Polygon as well as Base.
MCP server updated to 1.2.0.
Added /chain/nft and /chain/call; rewrote /chain/holders.
Added /chain/events, /chain/holders and /chain/transfers.
Added /chain/allowance and /chain/name.
Added the token safety check (/chain/token-safety).
/chain/balance works for any token.
/transcribe price set to $0.025.
/read price lowered to $0.0028.
Added the prompt-injection check and JSON repair.
/read returns Markdown first.
Added the news/RSS reader, Base on-chain pack, Chainlink prices, agent basics, /transcribe and /safe-batch.
Added the remote MCP server and its MCP Registry listing.
Uptime monitor now covers /safe-batch and the MCP server.
Launch: URL validation (/verify) and website safety (/safe), paid per call in USDC on Base via x402.
Uptime monitor started.
